evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/Activity Monitor.app/Contents/Info.plist (no document types, services or activities)

features.feature: CPU, Memory, Energy, Disk and Network tabs
features.note: Five tabs with per-tab columns and a graph card.
Click a header to sort; arrow shown in header.

features.feature: Process filters (all, mine, other users, system, active, inactive, windowed, GPU, selected)
features.note: Sidebar and View > Filter Processes now also offer Selected Processes (the selection and everything it started, via ppid) and GPU Processes (GPU share above 0). Windowed Processes remains: it needs the shell window list over the app SDK. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add Windowed Processes once the SDK exposes the shell window list (owner pids) to apps; filter on that set in model::visible_within.

features.apple: toolbar filter search field, Edit > Find
features.note: Toolbar search plus Process > Find Process (cmd+F) at main.rs:81.
SIGTERM / SIGKILL via toolbar and Process menu; no confirmation sheet.
features.wire: Show a confirmation sheet (Quit / Force Quit / Cancel) before signalling, as the reference does, in window.rs signal_selected.

features.note: Process > Send Signal... opens a sheet listing the eight signals with what each does, Cancel and Send; the submenu stays. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check the sheet on the lab machine (keyboard: Return to send, arrow keys to choose) and reuse it for the Quit and Force Quit confirmation.

features.feature: Inspect Process window (stats, memory, open files and ports)
features.apple: ProcessInspector.nib: Memory, Statistics, Open Files and Ports tabs
features.note: The inspector card now also shows the parent process (name and pid), page faults (minor and major) and context switches (voluntary and involuntary), read from /proc/<pid>/stat and status. Still a card in place of the graph, with no Memory/Statistics/Open Files segments and no reveal-in-file-manager link. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Turn the inspector into its own window with Memory / Statistics / Open Files and Ports segments, plus a Reveal in Files button for exe.

features.note: Process > Sample Process (and a toolbar Stop) looks at every thread of the selected process every 20 ms for 10 s on a background thread and shows the report (kernel wait stack, else wchan, else state, counted per thread) in the window, with Copy and Save.... No user-space call graph, and the duration is fixed. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a duration choice (3, 10, 30 s) and, where ptrace is permitted, user-space frames from /proc/<pid>/task/<tid>/syscall and a symbolizer.

features.apple: View > Run Spindump, Run System Diagnostics
features.note: View > Run System Diagnostics gathers 13 /proc files, the process list, journal tail, kernel log, disk usage and failed units into a zip (progress card with Stop), then opens the save panel. A zip chosen in the save panel, not a tarball on the Desktop; no system-wide stack sampling like spindump. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a system-wide sampling pass (every process, the Sample Process routine) and an option to write to the Desktop without the panel once the shell grants that.

features.note: Process > Show Deltas for Process stores a baseline for the selected pid (dropped when it exits); CPU Time, Bytes Read, Bytes Written and GPU Time count from it and the name carries a (deltas) mark. Sorting still uses the absolute figure. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Sort by the delta figure while a baseline is set, and keep several baselines visible with a column that shows the elapsed time.

features.note: View > Columns lists the optional columns of the current tab as checkable items (required ones are disabled) and stores the choice in app defaults (ColumnSet). Offers CPU Time, Parent PID, Virtual Size, 12 hr Average, Preventing Sleep, Bytes Read/Written, GPU Time, Packets In/Out. No Ports, Kind, Private or Purgeable memory, Idle Wake Ups. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add the remaining reference columns that have a Linux source: Ports (open sockets per pid), Private Mem (smaps_rollup Private_*), Idle Wake Ups (voluntary context switches per second).

features.note: View > Update Frequency 1/2/5 s, persisted in app defaults.
features.wire: Add View > Update Frequency radio items (1s/2s/5s) feeding next_wake in window.rs:161; persist it.

features.apple: CPU tab footer graph, Window > CPU History
features.note: View > CPU History swaps the CPU graph for one strip per core (from the cpuN lines of /proc/stat), kept in app defaults. No floating CPU History window. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add Window > CPU History as a floating panel when the SDK has a panel window level for apps.

features.feature: Floating CPU Usage window and Keep on Top
features.apple: Window > CPU Usage, Keep CPU Windows on Top
features.wire: Add a small always-on-top window via the SDK floating-panel level showing per-core bars.
Expose a dock badge/icon-image API in the SDK and add View > Dock Icon radio menu that renders the chosen live graph into the dock tile.

features.apple: Memory tab footer: pressure graph, app/wired/compressed, cached, swap
features.note: The Memory graph card shows App, Kernel, Shared, Cached Files, Compressed (zswap) and Swap Used from /proc/meminfo; pressure is still read from PSI in inspect.rs. The split is derived from meminfo, not the reference categories, and there is no pressure graph in the footer. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Draw the PSI pressure history as a small graph in the Memory footer and colour it green, yellow or red by threshold.

features.apple: Energy tab: Energy Impact, average, App Nap, Preventing Sleep
features.note: The Energy tab has a Preventing Sleep column (blocking sleep or idle locks from logind ListInhibitors via busctl, read every 10 s only while the column is shown) and an optional 12 hr Average column per process name (moving mean with a 12 hour time constant, since the app started, not stored). Energy impact is still a CPU and disk estimate; no App Nap column. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Persist the per-name averages across launches in app storage, and add an App Nap analogue from cgroup freezer or cpu.idle state.

features.feature: Disk tab: bytes per process and graph
features.note: Per-process read/write bytes from /proc/<pid>/io; system rates from diskstats.

features.apple: Network tab: sent/received bytes and packets per process
features.note: The Network tab keeps interface rows and adds optional Packets In and Packets Out columns from /proc/net/dev. Still per interface, not per process. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Attribute traffic per process with sock_diag (inode to pid via /proc/<pid>/fd) and the byte counters from the tcp_info netlink reply.

features.note: A GPU tab (% GPU, GPU Time, graph of the machine total) reads the DRM client usage counters in /proc/<pid>/fdinfo, only while the tab or the GPU filter is shown. Needs a kernel driver that publishes drm-engine-* (amdgpu, i915, xe, msm, panfrost, v3d); the NVIDIA proprietary driver does not. The history is the tab graph, not a separate floating GPU History window. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a Window > GPU History floating panel with one strip per engine, and an nvidia-smi fallback for the proprietary driver.

features.note: Edit > Copy (cmd+C) copies the row as tab-separated text of the columns the tab shows (View > Columns), counting from the baseline when Show Deltas is on. built on parity/team-d-activity-monitor; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Handle Edit > Copy in main.rs menu_action to put the selected row's columns as tab-separated text on the pasteboard.

features.note: Platform help book; no help viewer for system apps.
